{{Top|leg}}
'''Ion Alley''' was the name of the tunnel that allowed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to approach [[Exovar's Emporium]] on [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. It was equipped with an [[EXVR-1 Guardian Grid|EXVR-1 ion generation field]] that would disable unauthorized vessels.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|111|Ion Alley}}</ref>
